name: Chess MR – Chess in Mixed Reality
summary:
Bring the chessboard into your world.

Chess MR places a full-size chess table right in your room thanks to Meta Quest passthrough. A virtual opponent sits in front of you, thinks about its moves and plays them by hand, just like a real game across the table.

**Play naturally**
- Pick up and move pieces with your hands (hand tracking) or with the controllers
- Legal moves are highlighted as soon as you grab a piece
- After each move, press your button on the chess clock to pass the turn, just like in a rea
